collection_note: Safe-output typed breakdown (create_issue/create_pull_request/add_comment/create_discussion) and outcome status (accepted/rejected/ignored/pending) were not present as per-run fields in the agentic-workflows logs tool output for this window; only an aggregate safe_items_total count per run was available. safe_outputs_by_type and safe_output_outcomes are therefore omitted rather than reported as zero placeholders. Engagement metrics (reactions, PR comments, discussion replies) were not collected in this run due to time constraints on GitHub API calls across 154 active workflows; quality_indicators (merge/close times) were likewise not computed.
